name: Proton Drive
author: Proton AG
description: Proton Drive is an end-to-end encrypted Swiss vault for your files that protects your data.

versions.release_notes:
Improvements
- Updated activity button to pause the sync for set amount of time
- Added local space checking before on-demand hydration
- Improved error message for storage device I/O errors and unavailable local disk space
Bug Fixes
- Fixed orientation of in-app generated thumbnails

New Features
- Added option to pause the sync for set amount of time
Improvements
- Quality improvements

New Features
- This update lays the foundation for upcoming improvements, including a new SDK and updated cryptographic architecture. These behind-the-scenes changes help make the app faster, more efficient, and ready for future features.
Improvements
- Quality improvements

Improvements
- Photo import now extracts album names from Google Takeout exports
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where photo import could fail repeatedly

Improvements
- Photo import reuses equally named albums instead of creating duplicates
Bug Fixes
- Fixed false sync error when a folder with successfully imported photos is missing
- Resolved conflicts when folder syncs to both Proton Drive and Google Drive
- Fixed slow sync startup on every app launch affecting some users

Improvements
- Access albums via menu or directly when you reach your album limit during photo import

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a crash that occurred when uploading files

Improvements
- Enable early access to upcoming Proton Drive releases from the Settings page

Improvements
- Occasionally requires a CAPTCHA challenge to strengthen security

Bug Fixes
- Fixed rare issue related to importing duplicate Live Photos
- Fixed a crash that occurred when uploading certain images

Improvements
- Easier entry of two-factor authentication codes during sign-in
Bug Fixes
- Fixed import of duplicate Live Photos
- Fixed MIME type of OpenDocument files

Improvements
- You can now use a security key as a second factor authentication method for sign-in
Bug Fixes
- Fixed video creation-date detection when importing photos

Bug Fixes
- Fixes blocked sync for some users after an app update

New Features
- Added support for additional languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Slovak, Belarusian, Chinese, Hungarian, Indonesian, Romanian, Czech, and Greek

Bug Fixes
- Fixed errors when updating the app

Bug Fixes
- Fixed regression preventing account setup for new Proton Drive users

Bug Fixes
- Fixed app being stuck after removing other computers from Proton on web

Improvements
- Prevented adding a folder to My Computer page that conflicts with already synced folders
Bug Fixes
- Fixed minor issues

New Features
- Easily optimize storage of your synced folders right from the My Computer page

New Features
- Added support for the following languages: German, Spanish, French, Dutch, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Russian and Turkish
Improvements
- Improved error handling and messages

New Features
- Proton Drive app for Windows is now supported on ARM devices
Improvements
- Added on-demand file download progress on the Activity page
- Added initialization progress when it takes long due to many folders in My files
